name: [Portal] Sidebar + header layout shell (UI)
description:
### Summary

Umbrella task for the Partner Portal layout shell — the branded header and the sidebar from Figma frame [531:10086](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=531-10086&m=dev). The work splits cleanly in two because the two halves live in different layers, carry different risk and need different reviewers: the sidebar is data (section-map rows plus id-keyed CSS), while the header is a shared Smarty template every merchant sees. Each half is tracked in its own subtask and this ticket only holds them together. It closes when both subtasks close.

### Why?

This ticket originally specified „a new layout component under `admin/react/src/PartnerPortal/`, composed the way `PageLayoutDefault.tsx` composes `NavigationMenu` + `PageHeader`". That is not buildable as written, for three separate reasons found on 2026-09-23, so the original acceptance criteria have been replaced rather than merely split. See Technical notes. Every upcoming portal screen still needs the shell, so the work itself stands — only its shape changed.

### What?

A partner working in the admin sees the portal's own navigation and a header reduced to the Partner Portal logo and their user pill, matching the design. Page bodies stay placeholders — each nav destination has, or gets, its own ticket. Delivered by:

-  — the menu rows in `cms2_admin_section_map` and their sidebar icons. A SQL migration plus a LESS block.
-  — stripping the admin header down to the logo and the user dropdown on portal pages, and swapping in the Partner Portal wordmark.

The two land together visually: a portal page shows both the branded header and the portal navigation, checked against frame 531:10086 at desktop and mobile widths.

### Open questions

Both subtasks carry their own; two belong at this level because they decide the shape of the shell rather than the detail of either half:

- Portal-only sidebar, or the portal branch inside the normal admin menu? The design shows the four items as the whole sidebar. As children of the „Portál partnera" row they sit beside the merchant's full menu instead, which is a visibly different product. A portal-only sidebar is reachable through `cms2_admin_section_map.layoutTemplate` and a dedicated template, but that is a larger change than either subtask currently scopes.
- Flat menu or nested? This ticket's frame (531:10086) nests Přehled and Statistiky under Moje doplňky; the decision recorded on  the same day kept the menu flat (frame 739:11678). The subtasks follow the nested frame — confirm.

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Opus 5, 2026-09-23_

Why the original acceptance criteria were replaced:

1. `NavigationMenu`** renders no menu. **It ends in `return null` and exists only to attach Inertia click handling and active-state to DOM nodes Smarty already emitted. `PageHeader` is eleven lines of breadcrumbs plus system messages. Composing them differently produces nothing.
2. **The chrome is Smarty, outside React. **`admin/templates/layout/layout.tpl:10-38` renders the header (`afterHeader.tpl`) and the sidebar (`navigation.tpl`) as siblings of `<div id="app">`, the only node React mounts into. A React layout cannot suppress either. `PageLayoutDefault` also accepts no props — Inertia calls it as `layout(children)` — so there is nothing to parameterise; opting out is all-or-nothing via `PageLayoutBlank`.
3. **The path no longer exists. **Commit `9947faafc58e` (CZ3FRA1-133) moved `admin/react/` to `frontend/apps/admin-web/`; on master the portal frontend is `frontend/apps/admin-web/src/PartnerPortal/`.

Two consequences worth carrying into planning. Sidebar icons are not a database concept — there is no icon column on `cms2_admin_section_map` and the only mechanism is hardcoded LESS keyed by the row's auto-increment id (`public/cms/css/css_facelift/navigation.less:121-168`). And the menu is already being built piecemeal by three tickets:  adds „Obchody", the unmerged  branch already added „Moje doplňky" as `AddonsOverview` (id 2512), and  must reconcile with both rather than duplicate them.
